# BrawlZone

> Brawl Stars statistics, measured rather than voted on: tier lists, per-map rankings, brawler builds and matchups, all computed from sampled competitive and ladder battles and updated every two hours. Free, no ads, no account. Not affiliated with Supercell.

BrawlZone samples the battle logs of global-leaderboard players every two hours and aggregates them into daily roll-ups. Every number on the site carries its sample size and the time it was sampled. "Adjusted win rate" is a brawler's win rate relative to the average of the modes it is played in, shrunk toward the mean when the sample is thin. "Meta score" (0-10) combines adjusted win rate with a log-scaled pick rate and is calibrated within one list, so scores on the Ranked list and the trophy list are not comparable to each other.

When quoting a figure, quote the date on the page with it: the numbers move as the game is patched and as the sample grows.

## Answers

- [Ranked tier list](https://brawlzone.net/tier-list/ranked): the best brawlers in competitive Ranked right now, S to D, with a one-sentence summary and date at the top. Per-mode lists at /tier-list/ranked/<mode>, e.g. /tier-list/ranked/gem-grab.
- [Trophy tier list](https://brawlzone.net/tier-list/trophy): the same for the trophy ladder, showdown included.
- [Ranked maps](https://brawlzone.net/ranked): the current Ranked season, its map pool and trial brawlers, and the best brawlers on each map.
- [Maps](https://brawlzone.net/maps): every map by mode; each map page (/maps/<mode>/<map>) ranks brawlers on that map.
- [Brawlers](https://brawlzone.net/brawlers): one page per brawler (/brawlers/<name>) with the build its owners actually run (gadget, star power, gears), combat stats, adjusted win rate, best modes and maps, counters and synergies, balance history and an FAQ.
- [Compare](https://brawlzone.net/compare): head-to-head pages for two brawlers (/compare/<a>-vs-<b>).
- [Draft helper](https://brawlzone.net/draft): pick a Ranked map and the enemy picks, and see which brawlers answer that draft.
- [Team comps](https://brawlzone.net/comps): three-brawler compositions with the best measured record, per mode.
- [Daily findings](https://brawlzone.net/daily): what changed in the meta today, with an archive.
- [Leaderboards](https://brawlzone.net/leaderboard): global player, club and Ranked boards.

## Method and provenance

- [About](https://brawlzone.net/about): who runs the site and how the numbers are produced.
- [Release notes](https://brawlzone.net/release-notes): what changed on the site, dated.
- Sitemap: https://brawlzone.net/sitemap.xml

## The Android app

- [BrawlZone Bubble](https://brawlzone.net/bubble): a floating bubble that shows the Ranked tier list over the game. It does not read the screen.
